rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for work done beyond regular hours.

example.english: I have to stay and work overtime today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 jiu3 lau4 dai1 gaa1 baan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the extra money paid for working beyond regular hours.

example.english: The company still hasn't paid me my overtime pay.
example.traditional: 公司仲未出我嗰筆加班費。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zung6 mei6 ceot1 ngo5 go2 bat1 gaa1 baan1 fai3

rows.note: Use this for the extra period played after a tied sports match.

example.english: The final was tied, so they had to play overtime to decide the winner.
example.traditional: 決賽打和，要踢加時賽先分勝負。
example.jyutping: kyut3 coi3 daa2 wo4 jiu3 tek3 gaa1 si4 coi3 sin1 fan1 sing3 fu6
